recommendation: Review the videos with very high views but almost no likes or comments together with whoever runs paid promotion. Judge sale videos by link clicks and orders, not likes.
evidence: 39 videos have views far above their format's typical level but almost no likes; 11 are sale announcements. The cause (paid reach, Shorts feed, hidden likes) cannot be confirmed from public data.
how_to_test: Put a unique link on one such video and compare clicks with views.

recommendation: Promote a little the small videos where shoppers are asking questions, to see whether the same interest exists in a larger audience.
evidence: 15 videos are highly engaged despite low views, and 2 have many shopping questions (31 days with Sapphire - Week 1; Khaadi Spring Fabrics Collection’24.). Video age is not in our data, so these may simply be newer videos.
how_to_test: Spend a small budget on one such video and compare engagement per 1k views.

recommendation: Put the price and a product link in the first line of every product video's description, and pin a comment with the price.
evidence: 176 comments ask about price (29% of shopping comments). Highest share: Limelight at 10.0% of its comments (279 comments for this brand).
how_to_test: Publish the next 10 similar videos with the price in the caption and 10 without; compare the share of price questions.

recommendation: Influencer posts attract talk about the person, not the product. Show the product, its price and where to buy it in the first 10 seconds, and repeat it in a pinned comment.
evidence: Only 4.8% of comments under influencer posts are shopping-related (average across formats: 9.9%), while celebrity/music comments are 33.8%.
how_to_test: Re-cut one influencer video with an on-screen product card and compare its shopping-comment share with the original.

recommendation: For campaign films, name the song in the description, pin the full-song link, and add a shop link in the same pinned comment.
evidence: 17% of Khaadi's comments are music requests (lowest brand: 4%). These viewers are engaged but are not shopping.
how_to_test: Compare a film with song credit plus shop link against one without: count music and shopping questions.

recommendation: Test more 'Styling Video' content: it earns the most likes per view. Its median is almost the same as 'Sale Announcement' and it has only 49 videos, so start with a small test.
evidence: 'Styling Video': median 4.1 likes per 1k views (49 videos). Highest reach: 'Influencer Post' (33,124 median views).
how_to_test: Keep product and budget the same and change only the format.

recommendation: Assign a person or a reply template for return, exchange and 'fraud' comments.
evidence: 'complaints_and_misc_shopping_issues': 225 comments (25.5% of shopping comments), strong intent 20.0%, negative 21.8%. Top words: hai, sale, plz, hain, online, chahiye, order, aur.
how_to_test: Measure time to first reply and the share of negative comments.

recommendation: Pin a comment explaining how to order (website, outlets, WhatsApp) and announce launch dates for new collections in advance.
evidence: 'where_to_buy_and_collection_interest': 89 comments (10.1% of shopping comments), strong intent 15.7%, negative 1.1%. Top words: collection, nice, buy, amazing, beautiful, available, good, love.
how_to_test: Compare this group's share of comments before and after the pinned FAQ.

recommendation: When an item sells out, give a restock date or a notify-me link.
evidence: 'availability_and_restock_requests': 128 comments (14.5% of shopping comments), strong intent 14.1%, negative 12.5%. Top words: dress, dresses, clothes, wearing, available, fabric, like, buy.
how_to_test: Count restock requests before and after adding the notify-me link.

recommendation: Reply to delivery, refund and wrong-item comments within 24 hours.
evidence: 153 comments are complaints (2.5%). Highest share: Limelight at 8.6%, but this brand has only 279 comments, so the difference is not reliable.
how_to_test: Measure complaint comments per 1,000 and the time to first reply.

recommendation: Pin a warning about fake giveaways and links that use the brand's name, and list the official channels.
evidence: 3 comments mention fake giveaways or scam-like activity. Weak evidence: only 3 comments, and one of them is a question rather than a report.
how_to_test: Count such comments after the warning is pinned.

recommendation: State clearly when a sale starts and ends and which items it covers, in the description and a pinned comment. Answer 'discount?' questions with the sale link.
evidence: 85 comments ask about discounts or sales; 116 comments show clear buying intent (inbox, DM, WhatsApp, order).
how_to_test: Track clicks on the pinned link or use of a promo code.
